title: Japanese basics
variety: Standard Japanese, polite です/ます style
about: The most common words of written and spoken Japanese (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with the app's Japanese tokenizer and IPADIC: tools/course/ja/rank_ja.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out, and so are verb endings such as ます and た. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way native speakers do, in the polite です/ます style unless a plain form is what people really say, with its English translation; the meaning gives the reading in kana for words written with kanji, and ⟦ ⟧ marks the part of the translation that translates the word.
